Test Case Name: TC-001 Deploy Ceph Cluster
Test Case Description: Verify a new Ceph cluster is deployed and reaches HEALTH_OK before NVMe-oF setup.
Test Steps: 1. Provision MON/MGR/OSD nodes per deployment guide. 2. Bootstrap or deploy cluster. 3. Create RBD pool (e.g. nvmeof-pool). 4. Run ceph -s and ceph osd pool ls detail. 5. Record cluster FSID and Ceph version.
Results: Expected: ceph -s reports HEALTH_OK; RBD pool exists and is usable.

Test Case Name: TC-002 Verify Ceph RBD Baseline
Test Case Description: Confirm RBD create/map/unmap works independent of NVMe-oF.
Test Steps: 1. rbd create nvmeof-pool/test-image --size 10G. 2. rbd map nvmeof-pool/test-image. 3. dd if=/dev/urandom of=/dev/rbdX bs=1M count=100. 4. Read back and verify checksum. 5. Unmap and delete test image.
Results: Expected: RBD map/write/read/unmap succeeds with matching checksum.

Test Case Name: TC-003 Deploy NVMe-oF Gateway A
Test Case Description: Install and start first NVMe-oF gateway (CNC-enabled custom build) on GW-A.
Test Steps: 1. Install custom ceph-nvmeof gateway on GW-A. 2. Configure ceph.conf/keyring and gateway config. 3. Start gateway service. 4. Verify NVMe-oF port 5500 listening. 5. Record build version/commit.
Results: Expected: Gateway A active; nvmf_tgt running; RPC socket reachable.

Test Case Name: TC-004 Deploy NVMe-oF Gateway B
Test Case Description: Install and start second NVMe-oF gateway on GW-B for dual-GW ANA.
Test Steps: 1. Repeat TC-003 on GW-B with distinct gateway id. 2. Ensure both gateways in same ceph-nvmeof group. 3. Verify both healthy via gw list CLI. 4. Record GW-B build version.
Results: Expected: Gateway B active; both gateways visible and healthy.

Test Case Name: TC-005 Create NVMe Subsystem and Host Group
Test Case Description: Create subsystem with host ACLs for RHEL and ESXi NQNs.
Test Steps: 1. Create subsystem nqn.2016-06.io.spdk:cnc-test. 2. Add RHEL host NQN to host group. 3. Add ESXi host NQN. 4. Verify subsystem on both gateways. 5. Document NQNs.
Results: Expected: Subsystem created; both initiator NQNs authorized.

Test Case Name: TC-006 Create Multiple Namespaces Same Block Size
Test Case Description: Create multiple namespaces backed by separate RBD images same block size.
Test Steps: 1. Add NSID1 RBD image 10G 4096B. 2. Add NSID2 RBD image 10G 4096B. 3. Add NSID3 optional same format. 4. Wait for gateway state sync. 5. Verify namespace count on both GWs.
Results: Expected: All namespaces created; identical LBA format; visible on both gateways.

Test Case Name: TC-007 Configure ANA Groups Dual Gateway
Test Case Description: Configure ANA groups for Active/Optimized paths across GW-A and GW-B.
Test Steps: 1. Assign namespaces to ANA load-balancing groups via CLI. 2. Verify ANA state on GW-A. 3. Verify ANA state on GW-B. 4. Document ANA group to NSID to Active GW mapping. 5. Wait state update interval.
Results: Expected: ANA configured; each NS has documented Active path.

Test Case Name: TC-008 Connect RHEL Initiator to NVMe-oF
Test Case Description: Discover and connect RHEL host to both gateway IPs.
Test Steps: 1. Install nvme-cli and nvme-tcp on RHEL. 2. nvme discover -t tcp -a GW-A-IP -s 5500. 3. Connect subsystem to GW-A and GW-B. 4. nvme list-subsys and nvme list. 5. Record /dev/nvmeXnY per NSID.
Results: Expected: RHEL sees all namespaces; stable connection to both gateways.

Test Case Name: TC-009 Connect ESXi Initiator to NVMe-oF
Test Case Description: Add NVMe-oF datastores on ESXi using both gateway paths.
Test Steps: 1. Add NVMe/TCP adapter on ESXi if needed. 2. Discover subsystems on GW-A and GW-B. 3. Connect datastore backed by test namespaces. 4. esxcli nvme device list. 5. Create VMFS datastore for clone tests.
Results: Expected: ESXi connected; NVMe devices listed; VMFS created.

Test Case Name: TC-010 Enable CNC Logging on Gateways
Test Case Description: Enable nvmf_cnc debug logging on both gateways.
Test Steps: 1. GW-A: rpc.py log_set_flag -i nvmf_cnc and log_set_level DEBUG. 2. Repeat on GW-B. 3. Confirm log path writable. 4. Sync NTP between gateways and initiators.
Results: Expected: nvmf_cnc enabled on both gateways.

Test Case Name: TC-011 Configure CNC via RPC Default
Test Case Description: Apply default CNC config on both gateways.
Test Steps: 1. GW-A: nvmf_cnc_set_config --host-behav-support-cnc --rate-limit-bytes 40000000 --max-inflight 8 --chunk-nlb 512. 2. Repeat GW-B. 3. Confirm NOTICELOG config updated. 4. Record parameters.
Results: Expected: RPC succeeds; defaults chunk_nlb=512 max_inflight=8 rate_limit=40MB.

Test Case Name: TC-012 Configure CNC via RPC Production Tuning
Test Case Description: Apply production CNC tuning on both gateways.
Test Steps: 1. GW-A: nvmf_cnc_set_config --host-behav-support-cnc --rate-limit-bytes 400000000 --max-inflight 8 --chunk-nlb 512. 2. Repeat GW-B. 3. Verify no validation errors.
Results: Expected: RPC succeeds; 400MB rate limit active.

Test Case Name: TC-013 Verify Controller Copy Support
Test Case Description: Verify controller advertises Copy command (opcode 0x19).
Test Steps: 1. RHEL: nvme id-ctrl /dev/nvmeX -H. 2. Confirm ONCS Copy supported bit set. 3. Repeat from ESXi if tooling available.
Results: Expected: Controller identify shows NVMe Copy supported.

Test Case Name: TC-014 Verify Namespace CNC Advertisement
Test Case Description: Verify namespaces advertise cfs mcl mcd limits.
Test Steps: 1. nvme id-ns /dev/nvmeXn1 -H for each NS. 2. Record cfs mcl mcd. 3. Confirm cfs includes format 2. 4. Compare mcd to build spec.
Results: Expected: cfs=2; mcl and mcd valid; consistent block size.

Test Case Name: TC-015 ESXi Host Behavior Support Tolerance
Test Case Description: Verify target accepts ESXi Host Behavior Support reserved fields.
Test Steps: 1. ESXi reconnect or clone prep sending Set Features Host Behavior. 2. Monitor gateway logs. 3. Confirm cdfe format 2 bit 0x4 when ESXi supports XCOPY.
Results: Expected: ESXi connects without abort.

Test Case Name: TC-016 CNC Disabled via RPC Negative
Test Case Description: Verify copy rejected when host_behav_support_cnc disabled.
Test Steps: 1. nvmf_cnc_set_config --host-behav-support-cnc false on GW-A. 2. nvme copy --format=2 on RHEL. 3. Record status. 4. Re-enable CNC.
Results: Expected: Copy fails when disabled; succeeds after re-enable.

Test Case Name: TC-017 Write Known Test Pattern to Source NS
Test Case Description: Prepare source namespace with verifiable data pattern.
Test Steps: 1. fio write verify=crc32c on NSID1 size 2G. 2. Record LBA ranges and checksums. 3. Write distinct patterns at SLBA 5000 and 9000.
Results: Expected: Source has verified pattern; fio verify passes.

Test Case Name: TC-018 Single-Range Same-NS Copy RHEL
Test Case Description: Basic CNC single range same namespace format 2.
Test Steps: 1. Ensure pattern at SLBA 5000 NSID1. 2. nvme copy /dev/nvme1n2 --sdlba=1000 --slbs=5000 --blocks=1255 --snsids=1 --format=2. 3. nvme read source and dest regions. 4. cmp src.bin dst.bin. 5. Check nvmf_cnc logs.
Results: Expected: Copy success; data identical; CNC logged.

Test Case Name: TC-019 Multi-Range Same-NS Copy RHEL
Test Case Description: CNC multiple descriptors same namespace.
Test Steps: 1. Patterns at SLBA 5000 (99 blk) and 9000 (199 blk). 2. nvme copy --sdlba=1000 --slbs=5000,9000 --blocks=99,199 --snsids=1,1 --format=2. 3. Verify ranges at dest 1000 and 1099. 4. cmp each range.
Results: Expected: Both ranges correct; no cross-range corruption.

Test Case Name: TC-020 Cross-Namespace Copy RHEL
Test Case Description: CNC across two namespaces format 2 cross-NS.
Test Steps: 1. Write verified pattern to NSID1. 2. Copy snsid=1 to dest NSID2 device SDLBA 0. 3. Compare with cmp or fio verify. 4. Confirm format 2 in logs.
Results: Expected: Cross-NS copy succeeds; data matches.

Test Case Name: TC-021 Max Copy Descriptors Boundary
Test Case Description: Verify copy at exactly mcd descriptors.
Test Steps: 1. Read mcd from nvme id-ns. 2. Build copy with exactly mcd ranges within mcl. 3. Execute copy. 4. Verify all dest ranges.
Results: Expected: Copy with mcd descriptors succeeds.

Test Case Name: TC-022 Exceed Max Copy Descriptors Negative
Test Case Description: Verify copy fails when descriptors exceed mcd.
Test Steps: 1. Build copy with mcd+1 descriptors. 2. Execute nvme copy --format=2. 3. Record status and log.
Results: Expected: Rejected before IO; invalid descriptor error.

Test Case Name: TC-023 Max Copy Length Boundary
Test Case Description: Verify copy at exactly mcl total blocks.
Test Steps: 1. Read mcl from id-ns. 2. Single-descriptor copy total blocks=mcl. 3. Verify data.
Results: Expected: Copy at mcl succeeds with correct data.

Test Case Name: TC-024 Exceed Max Copy Length Negative
Test Case Description: Verify copy fails when total blocks exceed mcl.
Test Steps: 1. Copy with total blocks mcl+1. 2. Record status.
Results: Expected: Command rejected; no false success.

Test Case Name: TC-025 Large Copy with IO Chunking
Test Case Description: Verify large CNC split into chunks per chunk_nlb.
Test Steps: 1. Set chunk_nlb=512 via RPC. 2. nvme copy --sdlba=5000 --slbs=2000 --blocks=50000 --snsids=1 --format=2. 3. Review chunk logs. 4. Verify data.
Results: Expected: Success; multiple chunks in logs; data correct.

Test Case Name: TC-026 Concurrent CNC Commands RHEL
Test Case Description: Run parallel CNC commands from RHEL.
Test Steps: 1. Launch 4 parallel non-overlapping nvme copy commands. 2. Wait for completion. 3. Verify each dest range. 4. Monitor GW CPU memory.
Results: Expected: All succeed; no corruption; GW stable.

Test Case Name: TC-027 2GB Volume CNC Simulation RHEL
Test Case Description: 500 CNC commands copying 4MB each (~2GB).
Test Steps: 1. Prepare 2GB verified source. 2. Loop 500 nvme copy --blocks=8000. 3. Compare full 2GB dest to source. 4. Record elapsed time.
Results: Expected: All 500 succeed; 2GB dest matches source.

Test Case Name: TC-028 Destination LBA Out of Range Negative
Test Case Description: Invalid destination LBA rejected.
Test Steps: 1. nvme copy --sdlba=999999999999 --slbs=1000 --blocks=50 --snsids=1 --format=2. 2. Record status.
Results: Expected: LBA out of range error.

Test Case Name: TC-029 Source LBA Out of Range Negative
Test Case Description: Invalid source LBA rejected.
Test Steps: 1. Copy with --slbs=999999999999. 2. Record status.
Results: Expected: Error returned.

Test Case Name: TC-030 Invalid Source NSID Negative
Test Case Description: Non-existent source NSID rejected.
Test Steps: 1. nvme copy --snsids=99 --format=2. 2. Record status and log.
Results: Expected: Invalid namespace error.

Test Case Name: TC-031 Overlapping Copy Ranges Negative
Test Case Description: Overlapping ranges on same NS rejected.
Test Steps: 1. nvme copy --sdlba=1010 --slbs=1000 --blocks=50 --snsids=1 --format=2. 2. Record status.
Results: Expected: Overlapping range error.

Test Case Name: TC-032 Namespace From Different Subsystem Negative
Test Case Description: Source NS from another subsystem rejected.
Test Steps: 1. Connect second subsystem. 2. Attempt cross-subsystem copy. 3. Record status.
Results: Expected: Error; must be same subsystem.

Test Case Name: TC-033 Backend IO Failure During Copy
Test Case Description: Failed read/write returns failed completion.
Test Steps: 1. Start large copy blocks=50000. 2. Inject failure mid-copy (delete RBD or MOCK). 3. Record final status. 4. Verify dest not falsely successful.
Results: Expected: Failed status; no silent success.

Test Case Name: TC-034 Invalid CNC RPC Parameters Negative
Test Case Description: RPC rejects invalid chunk_nlb and max_inflight.
Test Steps: 1. Try chunk_nlb=0. 2. Try max_inflight=0. 3. Try max_inflight=33. 4. Confirm prior config unchanged.
Results: Expected: RPC invalid params; config retained.

Test Case Name: TC-035 CNC Rate Limiter Enforcement
Test Case Description: Rate limiter caps concurrent CNC bandwidth.
Test Steps: 1. Set rate-limit-bytes 1048576. 2. Run 4 concurrent large copies. 3. Measure throughput 60s. 4. Compare to unlimited.
Results: Expected: Throughput capped ~1MB/s; commands complete.

Test Case Name: TC-036 CNC Config Hot Update Double Buffer
Test Case Description: In-flight CNC uses old config; new applies to new commands.
Test Steps: 1. Start long copy blocks=50000. 2. Mid-flight change chunk_nlb 512 to 128. 3. Start second copy. 4. Compare chunk patterns in logs.
Results: Expected: First uses old chunk; second uses new; both correct.

Test Case Name: TC-037 Per-Gateway Independent Rate Limit
Test Case Description: GW-A and GW-B enforce independent limits.
Test Steps: 1. GW-A limit 1MB GW-B limit 400MB. 2. Same workload via each path. 3. Compare throughput.
Results: Expected: Each GW enforces its own limit.

Test Case Name: TC-038 Copy via Active ANA Path
Test Case Description: CNC succeeds when dest NS on Active ANA path.
Test Steps: 1. Identify Active GW for dest NSID. 2. Connect RHEL to Active GW. 3. Execute cross-NS copy. 4. Verify data.
Results: Expected: Copy succeeds via Active path.

Test Case Name: TC-039 Copy via Non-Active ANA Path
Test Case Description: Behavior when CNC sent to non-Active path.
Test Steps: 1. Force connection to non-Active GW for dest NS. 2. Execute CNC copy. 3. Document redirect or failure.
Results: Expected: Redirect to Active or clean failure; document actual.

Test Case Name: TC-040 ANA Failover During Active Copy
Test Case Description: CNC behavior during ANA/gateway failover mid-copy.
Test Steps: 1. Start large CNC. 2. Stop Active GW or change ANA state. 3. Observe retry and outcome. 4. Checksum dest.
Results: Expected: Fail clean or retry complete; no corruption.

Test Case Name: TC-041 Dual-GW Active-Active Load Spread
Test Case Description: CNC load distributes across gateways.
Test Steps: 1. Parallel ESXi clones or RHEL copies multi-path both GWs. 2. Monitor nvmf_cnc on GW-A and GW-B. 3. Compare aggregate vs single GW.
Results: Expected: Both GWs process CNC; aggregate throughput higher.

Test Case Name: TC-042 Same Cross-NS Copy via GW-A vs GW-B
Test Case Description: Identical result via either gateway.
Test Steps: 1. TC-020 via GW-A only. 2. Reset dest; repeat via GW-B. 3. Compare data and latency.
Results: Expected: Identical correct data; latency may differ.

Test Case Name: TC-043 ESXi VM Disk Clone with CNC
Test Case Description: Clone VMDK using XCOPY/CNC (primary VMware test).
Test Steps: 1. Create source VMDK with guest checksum. 2. Enable nvmf_cnc logs. 3. vmkfstools -i src.vmdk dst.vmdk. 4. Record duration. 5. Verify dst checksum. 6. Confirm opcode 0x19 format 2 in logs.
Results: Expected: Clone succeeds; CNC in logs; data matches src.

Test Case Name: TC-044 ESXi Remove Cloned VMDK
Test Case Description: Cleanup cloned VMDK.
Test Steps: 1. vmkfstools -U dst.vmdk. 2. Confirm removed from datastore.
Results: Expected: Clone file removed.

Test Case Name: TC-045 ESXi VM Migration Between Datastores
Test Case Description: Storage vMotion between NVMe-oF datastores.
Test Steps: 1. VM on datastore A. 2. Migrate to datastore B. 3. Record duration. 4. Boot VM verify data. 5. Check CNC logs.
Results: Expected: Migration completes; VM data intact; CNC in logs.

Test Case Name: TC-046 ESXi Cross-Datastore Clone
Test Case Description: Clone across different NVMe-oF datastores/namespaces.
Test Steps: 1. Source VMDK on NS A. 2. Clone to NS B via vmkfstools -i. 3. Verify cross-NS in logs and data.
Results: Expected: Cross-datastore clone succeeds.

Test Case Name: TC-047 ESXi Concurrent VM Clones
Test Case Description: 2-4 parallel VM clone operations.
Test Steps: 1. Prepare 2-4 source VMDKs. 2. Parallel vmkfstools -i. 3. Monitor GW CPU memory rate limiter. 4. Verify each clone.
Results: Expected: All succeed; GW stable; no cross-contamination.

Test Case Name: TC-048 ESXi Clone CNC Disabled Baseline A/B
Test Case Description: Compare clone latency CNC on vs off.
Test Steps: 1. Time TC-043 on CNC-enabled build. 2. Repeat on CNC-disabled baseline same VMDK size. 3. Calculate speedup.
Results: Expected: CNC enabled at least 2x faster; both data correct.

Test Case Name: TC-049 RHEL 2GB Copy Performance A/B
Test Case Description: Compare 500 CNC commands vs host read/write 2GB.
Test Steps: 1. Time TC-027. 2. Baseline script read+write 2GB without copy. 3. Calculate ratio.
Results: Expected: CNC significantly faster than host R/W.

Test Case Name: TC-050 CNC Chunk Size Performance Sweep
Test Case Description: Tune chunk_nlb measure large copy latency.
Test Steps: 1. chunk_nlb=128 run TC-025 record time. 2. Repeat 512 and 4096. 3. Note CPU usage.
Results: Expected: Document optimal chunk; all data correct.

Test Case Name: TC-051 CNC Max Inflight Performance Sweep
Test Case Description: Tune max_inflight measure latency.
Test Steps: 1. max_inflight=1 run TC-025. 2. Repeat 8 and 32. 3. Compare latency and CPU.
Results: Expected: Higher inflight helps to diminishing returns.

Test Case Name: TC-052 Dual-GW Aggregate Throughput vs Single Path
Test Case Description: Parallel clone throughput one GW vs both ANA paths.
Test Steps: 1. 4 parallel clones pinned GW-A only. 2. Repeat multi-path GW-A+GW-B. 3. Compare MB/s.
Results: Expected: Dual-path aggregate >= single GW.

Test Case Name: TC-053 Sustained CNC Load Soak Test
Test Case Description: 30-60 min continuous CNC detect leaks.
Test Steps: 1. Continuous CNC 30-60 min ESXi or RHEL loop. 2. Monitor GW RSS CPU every 5 min. 3. Check OOM or stuck commands.
Results: Expected: Stable memory CPU; no GW crash.

Test Case Name: TC-054 Full Volume Data Integrity fio Verify
Test Case Description: fio verify full-volume CNC copy compare.
Test Steps: 1. fio write verify=crc32c full src NS. 2. CNC copy entire volume within mcl limits. 3. fio read verify on dest NS.
Results: Expected: 100% verify pass on dest.

Test Case Name: TC-055 Sparse Region Copy Correctness
Test Case Description: Unwritten regions copy correctly.
Test Steps: 1. Write partial region src NS. 2. CNC copy full range incl unwritten LBAs. 3. Read unwritten dest region.
Results: Expected: Zeros or prior content per RBD; no garbage.

Test Case Name: TC-056 Ceph Recovery During CNC
Test Case Description: CNC during OSD recovery/backfill.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger OSD recovery. 2. Run large CNC during recovery. 3. Verify success or clean fail with checksum.
Results: Expected: No silent corruption.

Test Case Name: TC-057 Gateway Restart Mid-Copy Resilience
Test Case Description: GW restart during active CNC.
Test Steps: 1. Start large CNC from RHEL. 2. Restart gateway mid-copy. 3. Observe reconnect and outcome. 4. Checksum dest.
Results: Expected: Retry or fail; no corrupt dest.

Test Case Name: TC-058 MOCK Read Error Injection
Test Case Description: MOCK fault returns failed completion if build supports.
Test Steps: 1. Run gateway with MOCK read error. 2. nvme copy --sdlba=5000 --slbs=1000 --blocks=50 --format=2. 3. Record status.
Results: Expected: Failed completion not success.

Test Case Name: TC-059 nvmf_cnc Logging Content Verification
Test Case Description: nvmf_cnc logs contain expected fields.
Test Steps: 1. Enable nvmf_cnc. 2. Run TC-018. 3. Confirm logs: total blocks SDLBA descriptor count chunks inflight rate-limit release.
Results: Expected: All diagnostic fields present.

Test Case Name: TC-060 CNC Error Path Logging
Test Case Description: Validation failures produce clear error logs.
Test Steps: 1. Run TC-030 and TC-031. 2. Review ERRLOG/NOTICELOG.
Results: Expected: Clear messages for invalid NSID and overlap.

Test Case Name: TC-061 ESXi Snapshot Linked Clone
Test Case Description: Linked clone from snapshot base.
Test Steps: 1. Create VM snapshot. 2. Clone from snapshot base VMDK. 3. Boot clone verify snapshot state data.
Results: Expected: Linked clone data correct.

Test Case Name: TC-062 Block Size Mismatch Negative
Test Case Description: CNC rejected for mismatched block sizes.
Test Steps: 1. Create NS different LBA format if allowed. 2. Attempt cross-NS copy. 3. Record status.
Results: Expected: Block size mismatch error.

Test Case Name: TC-063 Coalescing Adjacent Descriptors
Test Case Description: Adjacent LBA descriptors coalesced for efficiency.
Test Steps: 1. Copy two adjacent descriptors. 2. Review nvmf_cnc IO count in logs. 3. Verify data.
Results: Expected: Fewer backend IOs; data correct.

Test Case Name: TC-064 Parallel Host Fio with CNC RHEL
Test Case Description: Host fio write/read concurrent with CNC copies on non-overlapping LBA ranges.
Test Steps: 1. Partition NSID1: fio region at low LBAs size 1G; CNC source at higher non-overlapping LBAs. 2. Start fio write/read verify=crc32c on fio region. 3. In parallel run CNC copy loop NSID1 to NSID2. 4. Wait for both; verify fio and CNC destinations. 5. Sample GW CPU/RSS.
Results: Expected: Both complete; no corruption on fio or CNC regions; gateway stable.
